item.title: Entrepreneurship and the Creation of Decent Work for All
item.content:encoded:
This multi-journal collection invites research exploring how entrepreneurship can contribute to achieving decent work for all, addressing UN Sustainable Development Goal 8. The call recognizes that labor markets and employment quality are shaped by societal, environmental, and economic disruptions, and entrepreneurship may play a key role in creating productive employment with fair wages and improved opportunities.

The collection seeks diverse perspectives on the intersection of entrepreneurship and working conditions, aiming to support policies and instruments that advance productive, decent work and equitable access to employment. Submissions may be research or review articles and will undergo peer review according to each participating journal's standards.

Appel publié par Small Business Economics. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Equal pay for work of equal value
  • Gender discrimination in employment
  • Immigration and employment
  • Labor shortages after COVID-19
  • Modern slavery and child labor
  • Labor policy
  • Entrepreneurial enterprises, SMEs, and family businesses
  • Global entrepreneurial firms: organization design, emerging conceptions in entrepreneurship (i.e. born globals), globalization's challenges and opportunities, cultural differences
  • Remote work
  • Opportunity entrepreneurship as a direct way to generate high quality employment
  • Measuring and dealing with positive and negative externalities of new businesses
